s: Im dirat goy meakkebet beerubo ubo k"g seipim: dirat nokri kedirat behema. Lepikak haddar im hannokri bechatzer eno oser alayv, ad sheyyihyu b' yisreelim darim bishne battim veoserim zeh al zeh, utzerikim leareb yachad — azay gam hannokri oser alehem, veen erubam moil ad shehannokri yaskir lahem reshuto shebbechatzer. Velo mishshum sheddirato dira, ella mippene shechasheshu chakamim shemma yilmedu hayyisreelim mimmaaseh hannokri kesheyyaduru bechatzer achat, ubiqshu illa limnoa dirat hayyisrael im hannokri, velaken ameru sheen erub moil bimqom nokri veen bittul reshut moil benokri ad sheyyaskir, vehannokri lo yirtzeh lehaskir mippene sheyyachush likshapim, veyiqsheh beene hayyisrael dirato immo mippene issur tiltul, veyetze mishsham. Ulepi sheeno matzuy sheyyadur yisrael echad im nokri bechatzer, mippene sheyyachush leatzmo shemma yahargennu, ki hannokrim chashudim al shepikat damim — laken lo hutzreku leesor alayv hattiltul mishshum dirat hannokri kede sheyyetze mishsham. Abal b' yisreelim enam yereim mimmennu vedarim immo, veyilmedu mimmaasayv. Umikkol maqom im yisreelim rabbim darim bebayit echad — eno oser alehem, ap al pi sheenam yereim mimmennu, ki lo ratzu chakamim lachaloq ben bayit sheddar bo echad lebayit sheddarim bo harbeh, vehittiru bebayit echad bekol inyan. Velo od ella apillu battim harbeh shebbechatzer vehem kebayit echad, sheenam oserim zeh al zeh, kegon haachin sheddarim kol echad bebayit bipne atzmo umeqabbelim peras meabihem haddarim im hannokri bechatzer, vekol kayyotze bahem mimmah shennitbaer besimman sh"a sheen tzerikim leareb benehem — en tzerikim gam ken liskor reshut minnokri haddar immahem bechatzer:

Yisrael shehiskir o hishil bayit lenokri bechatzer — eno oser alayv, ap al pi sheyyesh od yisrael dar immo bechatzer, lepi shello hiskir o hishil lo beto al daat sheyyeesor alayv (veap al pi shebbemaskir o mashil leyisrael en omerim ken, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a — gabbe nokri heqellu). Abal im habbayit shel nokri usekaro yisrael mimmennu, vehannokri dar immo becheder bipne atzmo beinyan sheoser alayv kemo sheyyitbaer — en sekirat habbayit moelet leinyan sekirut lehattir tiltul, ella tzarik lachazor veliskor mimmennu kede lehattir tiltul (sheim lo ken lo yiqsheh beenayv dirato immo velo yetze mishsham):

Yisrael sheyyesh lo b' battim bechatzer shennokri dar bah, vehu dar beechad mehem, vehashsheni hishil o hiskir leyisrael acher, veyesh lo bo tepisat yad, dehaynu kelim sheenam nittalim beshabbat — ap al pi shehem enam tzerikim leareb benehem, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a, tzerikim liskor mehannokri, lepi shettepisat yad en lah lehoil yoter mishsheillu erebu benehem, sheeno moil leorbam uleshattepam sheyyihyu keyachid bimqom nokri, sheen hannokri oser alayv:

Im bittelu hayyisreelim reshutam leechad mehem kede sheyyechasheb keyachid bimqom nokri — eno moil lo, sheyyesh lachush shebbekol shabbat yaasu kak vetitbattel torat erub meotah chatzer. Veim yearebu, yesh lachush sheyyitu lomar erub moil bimqom nokri:

Im en lannokri derisat haregel al hayyisreelim — eno oser. Kegon b' chatzerot happetuchot zo lezo veen lahen derisat haregel zo al zo, dehaynu sheen zo lipnim mizzo ella zo betzad zo, ushettehen petuchot lemaboy, ubeachat mehen dar nokri ubashsheniyya darim b' yisreelim o yoter — maknisim umotziim mizzo lezo derek petachim vechallonot shebbenehen, veenam tzerikim liskor mehannokri ella im ken rotzim lehishtattep bammaboy, sheaz hu oser alehem bammaboy, kevan sheyyesh lo bo derisat haregel:
Hassoker min hannokri setam — moil, veeno tzarik leparesh lo shehu lehattir hattiltul, veeno tzarik liktob shum ketiba al hassekirut:

Sokerim min hannokri apillu bepachot mishshaveh peruta, lepi shellegabbe ben noach apillu pachot mishshaveh peruta nechshab lo mamon. Abal yisrael sheeno rotzeh lebattel reshuto ella lehaskir — en pachot mishshaveh peruta nechshab lo mamon kelal, ap al pi shehu mitratztzeh bo. Veap al pi sheim haya mebattel bechinnam haya moil, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno rotzeh ella lehaskir, usekirut en kan ubittul en kan, shehabbittul hu shemmesalleq atzmo mereshut, vezeh lo silleq atzmo ella lehaskir:

Muttar liskor min hannokri apillu beshabbat, veen bezeh mishshum miqqach umimkar, shehare eno qoneh reshut min hannokri ella sokerah. Veap shessekirut gam ken asurim beshabbat mishshum sheddomeh lemiqqach umimkar, shennoten lo damim bead hachepetz shessoker kemo shehalloqeach noten bead hammeker — mikkol maqom kan, kevan sheeno soker reshuto kede lehishtammesh bah ella lehattir hattiltul bilbad, im ken haddamim shennoten lo eno ella mattana beolma, veeno domeh lemiqqach umimkar, shennoten lo bead hammeker hanniqneh lo lehishtammesh bo. Abal liqnot reshut beshabbat — asur, ap sheeno qoneh ella lehattir tiltul, vaapillu bemattenat chinnam, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"p ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqk"ch:

Kol zeman sheen hannokri chozer bo — moelet hassekirut, vaapillu lizman merubbeh. Veeno yakol lachazor bo missekiruto ad sheyyachazir haddamim im chozer bo qodem shabbat rishona. Veim hecheziqu bechatzer qodem shechazar bo — shub eno yakol lachazor bo leshabbat zo, ap al pi shemmachazir haddamim. Vehu shehecheziqu achar kenisat shabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"a. Abal leshabbat haacheret yakol lachazor bo ap al pi sheeno machazir haddamim, kevan shekkebar hoila sekiruto leshabbat achat. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshessakeru mimmennu setam velo pereshu lo zeman. Abal im sakeru mimmennu lizman, eno yakol lachazor bo betok hazzeman, ad sheyyachazir haddamim lepi erek orek hazzeman hannishar (veken im sakeru mimmennu leolam beperush):

Im sakeru mehannokri lizman yadua — kesheyyikleh hazzeman tzarik lachazor veliskor mimmennu shenit, vetzarik lachazor uleareb, sheen erub harishon chozer veneor, shekkebar nitbattel biklot hazzeman (veeno domeh leereb leshana venistam happetach bechol veniptach beshabbat, shehaerub chozer veneor kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"d, lepi shebbishat asiyyato naasa ap leshabbat zo, velo haya omed lehitbattel bitchillat shabbat zo, shehare happetach shehaya patuach az lo haya omed lihyot nistam bitchillat shabbat zo. Mah sheen ken kan, shebbishat asiyyat haerub haya omed lehitbattel kesheyyikleh zeman hassekirut ad sheyyachzeru veyiskeru shenit, vahare zeh domeh leba nokri beshabbat sheyyitbaer besimman shp"g):

Im sakeru min hannokri lizman yadua, ubetok hazzeman hiskir hannokri dirato lenokri acher — day biskirut harishon, shello nitbattela bemah shehiskirah leacher, lepi shebbezeh lo silleq napsho mimmenna kevan shelleachar zeman tachazor lo, vahare zeh keillu lo zaza yado mimmenna kelal, vahare hi ap akshav birshuto. Abal im met, o shemmekarah leacher betok hazzeman — tzarik lachazor veliskor mehayyoresh o mehalloqeach, shekkebar pasaq reshut harishon venitbattela sekiruto, kemo shehayyisrael sheereb umet nitbattel erubo, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"a:

Chamishsha haddarim bechatzer echad enam tzerikim kol echad liskor mehannokri haddar immahem, ella echad soker bishbil kullam. Veeno tzarik leparesh lo gabbe sekirut sheyyaskir lekullam, ella soker leatzmo vekullam muttarim, shekkevan shehu ereb immahem — hare kullam keish echad, veday sheyyaskir leechad mehem, kemo shelleinyan erub im hem rotzim leareb im chatzer acheret — day sheechad mehem yitten happat apillu mishshello vekullam muttarim, kevan shekkebar ereb immahem, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"b:

Im sakeru mimmennu beal korcho — eno moil, apillu haya ragil lehaskir miqqodem. Veeno domeh leerub, sheyyisrael haragil leareb notelin mimmennu erubo beal korcho, lepi shehayyisrael anu yekolim lekuppo leqayyem debar mitzva shehurgal bah, mah sheen ken benokri:

Abal meishto o bene beto, o apillu missekiro uleqito (shebbebeto) — sokerim, ap al pi shehu mocheh, shekkevan sheddirat hannokri enah oseret ella kede shello yilmod mimmaasayv, heqellu bah lihyot apillu sekiro nechshab kamohu, lepi shellipamim gam hassakir lo yirtzeh lehaskir veyetze hayyisrael mishsham. Umizzeh hattaam apillu sekiro shel sekiro yakol lehaskir kemo hassakir atzmo, vaapillu im hassakir [u]baal habbayit mochim:

Im en hannokri rotzeh lehaskir, yitqareb lo echad mibbene hechatzer veyeaseh ohabo, ad sheyyashil lo hannokri maqom birshuto sheyyehe lo reshut lehanniach bo shum dabar, veaz anu roim keillu yisrael zeh hu dar etzel hannokri, ap al pi sheadayin lo hinniach etzlo shum dabar, raq sheqqana mimmennu beechad mehadderakim sheqqarqa niqneh bahem, venaaseh yisrael zeh keillu hu sekiro o leqito (shebbebeto) umaskir shello middato. Veyesh omerim sheeno tzarik lehaskir, ella noten erubo im bene hechatzer bishbil beto, vedayyo bekak gam bishbil bet hannokri, shekkevan sheereb immahem naasu kullam keish echad, vekevan shehu naaseh sekiro, shehu nechshab kebaal habbayit bebet hannokri — hare yesh lekullam cheleq birshut hannokri kamohu, kemo sheechad mibbene hechatzer hassoker reshut mehannokri — yesh lekullam cheleq biskirut zo. Ulekattechilla yesh lachush lisbara harishona:

Im hishil lo maqom meyuchad beinyan shello yukal (lesalleqo mimmaqom zeh) ulehishtammesh bo beatzmo, shennimtza hannokri mesullaq mehayyisrael bemaqom zeh sheyyiched lo vehayyisrael mesullaq mehannokri mishshear habbayit, sheen lo reshut lehanniach sham chapatzayv — ap al pi shello menao mimmennu beperush, ella shello natan lo reshut — eno yakol lehaskir shello middato (vaapillu hu sekiro o leqito veyiched lo cheder bebeto ladur bo, im hu beinyan sheeno yakol lesalleqo mimmennu ulehishtammesh bo beatzmo — eno yakol lehaskir shello middato, shehare hannokri mesullaq mimmennu vehu mehannokri). Lepikak im yisrael venokri darim bebayit echad kol echad becheder bipne atzmo, tzarik liskor mehannokri uleareb im hayyisrael. Veen hayyisrael yakol lehaskir reshut hannokri, hoil veen hannokri yakol lesalleqo vehu en lo reshut lehanniach chapatzayv becheder hannokri. Vehu haddin benokrim haddarim beinyan zeh bebayit echad — tzarik liskor mishshenehem:

Sakeru missekiro uleqito lizman yadua, ap al pi shessilleqo tok hazzeman mihyot sekiro uleqito — muttarim ad tom hazzeman. Abal im sakeru mimmennu setam, kevan shessilleqo — nitbattel hassekirut. Veap al pi shebbeshaa shehu sekiro yesh lo koach lehaskir kebaal habbayit beatzmo, vehammaskir veshoteq — kol zeman sheeno chozer bo moelet sekiruto apillu lizman merubbeh, mikkol maqom meachar sheen kocho biskiruto ella mitztzad baal habbayit shessakar oto leshorto, venechshab keillu hu baal habbayit, im ken keshessilleqo baal habbayit — hare zeh keillu chozer bo baal habbayit missekiruto, vehammaskir setam yakol lachazor bo achar shabbat rishona, ap al pi sheeno machazir haddamim (mah sheen ken bemaskir lizman kemo shennitbaer lemala). Vehu haddin im sakar miggizbar hammelek venistalleq haggizbar, vehu shessilleqo legamre, sheshshub eno okel peras hammelek. Abal im lo silleqo ella mehaggizberaut, vaadayin hu okel peras shello — hare hu kiskiro uleqito vesokerin mimmennu lekattechilla, vekol shekken shello nitbattela sekirut harishona. Vehu haddin kol ebed meabde hammelek haqqetannim (shebbebeto) — sokerim mehen kemo shessokerim miskiro uleqito shel baal habbayit (vehu haddin shessokerim meabde abadayv, kemo shessokerim missekiro shel sekiro):

Nokri sheyyesh lo Hashem yisreelayam sekirim uleqitim darim bachatzero, kol echad becheder o bayit bipne atzmo — enan oserim zeh al zeh, kevan sheen diratam shellahem ella shel hannokri, vehu yakol lesalleqam, veeno mashil lahem reshutam sheyyaasru zeh al zeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a. Veen diratam chashuba dira ella lehaqel, sheyyekolim lehaskir shello middato, abal lo lehachamir, sheyyaasru zeh al zeh. Veken im sakeru min hannokri reshuto — en shum echad mehem tzarik litten erub (vekol shekken im hem hiskiru reshut hannokri, shehare gam diratam biklal):

Nokri shehiskir beto lenokri acher, im nishar lo lammaskir reshut bebeto sheyyukal lehanniach bo shum kelim — yekolim liskor mimmennu. Velo maskir bilbad ella kol adam sheyyesh lo reshut bebet nokri lehanniach bo shum dabar yakol liskor mimmennu, mippene shennaaseh kiskiro uleqito kemo shennitbaer. Ella sheddibru chakamim bahoveh, shessetam maskir mashir lo reshut bebeto lehanniach bo chapatzayv. Abal im lo nishar lo reshut bebeto, im yakol hammaskir lesalleq et hassoker mibbeto tok zemanno — yekolim liskor mimmennu, veim lav — eno moil ella im ken yiskero mehassoker:

Shette chatzerot zo lipnim mizzo, veyisrael echad venokri bappenimit veyisrael echad bachitzona — happenimi muttar bachatzero, sheen hannokri oser al yisrael yechidi, abal bachitzona oser hu ad sheyyaskir (lahem reshut derisat raglo bah), (shehare ragle b' yisreelim venokri metzuyim bah). Veken im yisrael echad bappenimit veyisrael echad venokri bachitzona. Vaapillu im nokri bappenimit ub' yisreelim bachitzona veerebu — oser hannokri alehem, ap al pi sheim haya yisrael lo haya oser alehem bidrisat raglo, hoil vehi regel hammutteret bimqomah, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"h:

Chatzer sheyyisrael echad venokrim darim bah, veyesh bayit echad shel yisrael etzel beto shel zeh, veeno patuach lechatzer zo ella lebayit zeh hu patuach bechallonot, velo bepetach gamur — eno yakol leareb immo al yede hachallonot shebbenehem kede lehotzi kelayv lechatzer zo derek bayit zeh happatuach lechatzer zo, lepi sheasur laasot siyyua leyachid sheyyadur im nokri, shello yilmod mimmaasayv. Lepikak ameru shello yeareb zeh immo velo yishtammesh immo bachatzero, kede sheyyihyeh yechidi bachatzero veyityare mehannokri shello yahargennu veyetze mishsham. Abal im hem petuchim zeh lezeh bepetach gamur — muttar leareb immo, lepi sheap im lo yeareb immo velo yishtammesh bachatzero lo yityare mehannokri, lepi shennireh lo keillu dar im yisrael zeh bebeto, kevan shebbattehem petuchim zeh lezeh bepetach gamur:

Chatzer sheyyisreelim venokri sheruyim bah, vechallonot petuchim mibbet yisrael zeh lebet yisrael zeh, veerebu al yede hachallonot shebbenehem — ap al pi shehem muttarim lehotzi mibbayit lebayit derek hachallonot, hare hem asurim lehotzi derek pitchehem (happetuchim lechatzer) mippene hannokri (sheoser alehem hechatzer), ad sheyyaskir (lahem reshuto shebbechatzer):

Sepina sheyyesh bah yisreelim rabbim, veyesh lahem battim meyuchadim lekol echad bassepina — tzerikim leareb yachad veliskor reshut minnokri baal hassepina (im yesh gam lo bayit meyuchad baspina velo natan reshut leyisreelim ellu lehanniach shum dabar bebeto, vegam en lo reshut lehanniach shum dabar bebattehem, sheaz hem mesullaqim zeh mizzeh, kemo shennitbaer lemala), o yabliu sekirut hetter tiltul biskar hassepina. Abal im lo hibliu lo beperush — en sekirut hassepina moelet lehattir tiltul, kemo shennitbaer lemala:
